text_block_list.text:
At last, our challenge of the Twinkle 
Series with Agnes Tachyon has begun!

Today is that very first day! Together 
with Agnes Tachyon, we'll discuss future 
prospects and set our goals—
—...Or so it was supposed to be.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're awake! My guinea 
p--Trainer-kun.

"Before I knew it, I was standing on a 
sun-drenched sports ground under a clear 
sky."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Calm yourself. This is virtual space. VR, 
as they call it. Just a commercial unit 
I've tweaked a little, you see."

In my shock, I hadn't even noticed the 
feel of the goggles and headphones. As I 
lift the goggles—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, don't do anything crude! This is a 
crucial experiment that my entire research 
career is riding on!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
“—The more capable an athlete is, the 
superior their underlying brain functions 
are. This holds true for Umamusume as 
well.”

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hypothetically, if you, an ordinary human, 
were to gain a physique equivalent to a 
typical Umamusume, how well could your 
brain adapt to an Umamusume's body?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I want to data-mine the variance between 
an Umamusume's physical capabilities and 
latent brain functions to apply toward 
unknown technologies. Today is merely a 
test run for that.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, in short, we'll be running 
alongside each other in virtual space. 
Sounds fascinating, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's the memorable first day of 
taking on the Twinkle Series! Let's give 
it our all!

Saying that, she put the goggles back on 
me—

"What was supposed to be a day of uniting 
as one and joining hands for the start of 
the Twinkle Series—"

Just as expected, I ended up getting swept 
along at Agnes Tachyon's pace.

Before I knew it, I was in the starting 
position.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In this virtual space right now, there is 
an Umamusume body that can be controlled 
by your brain. A body that prominently 
reflects the level of your latent brain 
function, that is.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You just need to do what you normally do 
when running. In other words, if you 
decide to "run," you can run.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It might feel awkward to control at first, 
but the more you run, the smoother it'll 
get. For now, just relax. Got it?

It seems I have no right of refusal. The 
track I usually look at suddenly looks 
completely different.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
To explain a bit further, this virtual 
version of me is essentially myself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My physical abilities are reflected in it, 
and moreover, it is my brain controlling 
it, after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, this is essentially a tandem 
run between you and me.
choice_data_list:
(To think the day would come when I'd run 
alongside her...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
ECG, heart rate, respiration, and EMG 
measured and recorded! Yep, good, good, 
good!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Listen. Giving it your all is what 
matters. Run with the intention of 
catching up to me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Listen carefully to my exact words. I 
said, "as if I were."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, at any rate, we don't have time! 
It'll be a hassle if we stay past curfew!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now then... time to begin the experiment!

Saying that, Agnes Tachyon dashed off with 
immense vigor.

Lights, sounds, colors streaming by at 
high speed... Heartbeat, wind, and kicking 
dust...!

The speed of an Umamusume, said to reach 
up to 70 km/h, was truly breathtaking!
choice_data_list:
(That's absolutely impossible for a human 
body!)

text_block_list.text:
...And while I was lost in awe, she, who 
was supposed to be running right ahead of 
me, pulled away in the blink of an eye.

Her back pulled away relentlessly. No 
matter how hard I struggled to catch up, 
the gap never narrowed.
choice_data_list:
(Sh-she's fast! We're both umamusume, so 
how...!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah, hah...!

She's a problem child who cares for 
nothing but research, but her talent is 
truly on another level.

And yet, she greedily continues to seek 
even greater speed. "Faster, even faster!" 
she cries...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hey you! You're way too late!

I thought I heard Agnes Tachyon's laughter 
from far up ahead.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: So, how did it go!?
choice_data_list:
I was reminded once again just how fast 
you really are!

It really hit me again just how fast you 
are!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I know that much! What else? How did it 
feel when you ran?"
choice_data_list:
I understand now what it means to want to 
explore an Umamusume's potential.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Is that so? It must have been quite 
shocking!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you seem to understand! It's so 
much easier to talk once we share a common 
language. Unexpected, but not a bad 
harvest at all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, you still haven't answered my 
question. Ah, very well, let me rephrase 
it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Are you in any pain? How fatigued are you 
feeling?

Experiencing such speed for the first 
time, I was lightheaded with a headache 
and dizziness.
choice_data_list:
Looks like she's about to collapse any 
second.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! I see! That makes sense! Now that's 
interesting! I see, I see!

After working herself up into excitement, 
Agnes Tachyon raised a single hand in 
satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That yielded some fascinating data. Thank 
you. Well then, I shall take my leave.

With that, she turned on her heel and 
walked away. After seeing her off, I 
turned back toward the Trainers' Roomâ
choice_data_list:
(...I feel like I'm forgetting something 
important.)

text_block_list.text:
—I recall holding a meeting in the 
Trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What is it? I'm busy.
choice_data_list: I need to get back to the meeting!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, so you noticed.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The meeting is postponed until tomorrow! 
Something just came up.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"If it's tomorrow, I'll go if I can make 
it. Though if I can't, I won't."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh, don't get so worked up. Besides, even 
if I promised to go tomorrow—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
There's no guarantee you'll be able to 
make it, right?
The next day.

True to those ominous words, I suffered 
terrible dizziness and couldn't take a 
single step out of my room—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you were able to experience the 
mysteries of the Umamusume firsthand, 
there could be no greater experience for a 
Trainer. Don't you agree?

Agnes Tachyon came by to visit for just 5 
minutes.

All in all, the days of searching for 'the 
limits of an Umamusume's potential' 
alongside Agnes Tachyon had begun...!
